Channels.note: Product name, keep in English; the common noun 'channel' is 'canal'.

SSO.note: When spelled out, use 'authentification unique (SSO)'; keep the abbreviation itself.

MFA.note: Spelled out as 'authentification multifacteur (MFA)' where needed.

Gossip.note: The clarification 'Bavardage (gossip protocol)' is acceptable; never translate alone as 'bavardage'.

System Console.note: Feminine. Lowercase in running text; capitalize only as a menu item ('Console système').

marketplace.note: Masculine 'marché' alone means a physical market. Webapp strings use bare 'marché'; server strings already use 'place de marché'.

post.note: Use 'publication' only for the root message of a thread or integration-posted content.

message.note: Masculine. A user 'envoie' (sends) a message; the system 'publie' (posts) system messages.

thread.note: Masculine. 'fil' alone is acceptable when space is tight or on repeat mentions.

direct message.note: Webapp/server consistently use 'message personnel'; mobile inconsistently uses 'message direct'. Never 'message direct' or 'DM'.

group message.note: Webapp also uses 'conversation de groupe' in places; 'message de groupe' is the community-rules rendering and mobile majority.

notification.note: Feminine. Order: 'notification par e-mail', 'notifications push' — put 'notification' first.

saved messages.note: Webapp majority is 'messages marqués' (legacy of 'flagged'); mobile uses 'messages enregistrés', which matches the save='enregistrer' rule and may be the better long-term choice. Verb save: 'enregistrer'.

scheduled post.note: Majority rendering; 'programmé' also appears (esp. verb 'programmer le brouillon'). Pick one per surface but stay consistent.

status.note: 'statut' for user availability; existing translations use 'état' for system/job status.

away.note: Agreement: 'absent(e)' when referring to a specific user; mobile uses 'Absent(e)' in places.

out of office.note: As a status label: « Absent du bureau ».

guest.note: Not 'invité' alone, which produces awkward phrases like 'inviter des invités'.

join.note: For channels/teams/calls. 'joindre' is reserved for attaching files.

mute.note: Channel notifications context. Muted: 'en sourdine'; unmute: 'réactiver' or 'enlever la sourdine'.

favorite.note: Noun: 'favori' (m.); category: 'Favoris'. Verb: 'mettre en favori' / 'ajouter aux favoris'.

webhook.note: Kept in English (masculine) — consistent across 60+ existing strings.

trigger word.note: Community-rules rendering; 'mot déclencheur' also appears in server strings.

permission.note: Feminine. Not 'droit' or 'autorisation' for role capabilities.

scheme.note: Permission-scheme sense. For URI/URL scheme use 'protocole URL' instead.

channel header.note: Masculine. Webapp uses 'en-tête'; older server/mobile strings use 'entête' — prefer 'en-tête'.

channel purpose.note: 'purpose' is 'description' in this context, not 'objet' or 'but'.

urgent.note: Label: 'Urgent'; feminine agreement 'priorité urgente' when qualifying 'priorité'.

recap.note: No existing French translation yet (new AI feature); 'récapitulatif' (m.) is the natural rendering, 'résumé' being reserved for 'summary'.

agent.note: Masculine; same word in French for AI agents.

burn-on-read.note: No existing French translation yet. For short badges (BURN ON READ) 'AUTODESTRUCTION' may be needed for space.

magic link.note: No existing translation yet; 'lien magique' is the established rendering in French SaaS (Slack, Notion).

nickname.note: Existing user-settings label; 'surnom' appears in some admin strings — prefer 'pseudo' for the profile field.

display name.note: 'nom affiché' also appears; prefer 'nom d'affichage' (desktop and admin majority).

collapsed reply threads.note: Singular 'fil de discussion repliable'. Mobile has older inconsistent renderings.

data retention.note: Admin console uses 'rétention des données'; 'conservation de données' also appears — prefer 'rétention'.

compliance export.note: Existing strings vary ('vérification de conformité de l'exportation' is a mistranslation); 'export de conformité' matches the feature.

onboarding.note: 'processus d'intégration' in existing admin strings; avoid 'inscription' which appears once and means registration.

Town Square.note: Established default-channel name in server fr.json; keep consistently.

Off-Topic.note: Established default-channel name in server fr.json.
